abstract_backfill.abstract: The authors regret that a typographical error was identified in Table 1 of the published article. The number of patients reported as having pathologic stage T3a in the validation cohort was incorrectly listed as 115 (22) and should read 215 (40). This correction does not affect any analyses, results, or conclusions presented in the manuscript. The authors would like to apologise for any inconvenience caused.
